concerns.text: FR-001 clause (4) requires a pilot human manipulation check (≥80% of a separate coder panel confirming moral-narrative preservation, SECONDARY check). T003 implements only CLIP/RMS/texture/SSIM checks and tags [FR-001]; no task delivers the human manipulation check. This is a silent drop of an acceptance criterion, not a documented staging.

T002 requires ≥3 real annotator rating files in data/raw/human_coding/ and raises InsufficientAnnotatorsError otherwise, but no task produces or sources those files. The FR-008 mandatory human coding step has an orphan input; the pipeline as tasked cannot execute FR-008 end-to-end.

T004 requires each logged row to conform to BOTH response contracts, but they are mutually exclusive under additionalProperties:false (variant_id+valid vs stimulus_id+user_id+attention_check_pass+completion_status). The task as written is unsatisfiable; one schema must be designated or the schemas reconciled.

T003 requires the manifest to conform to both stimulus contracts, which have disjoint required fields and identifiers (stimulus_id/artifact_flag/semantic_similarity vs variant_id/clip_similarity/moral_intent_preservation_score), both additionalProperties:false. Unsatisfiable as written.

FR-002/FR-003 require collecting blame ratings from real participants; T004 only builds the randomization/logging engine and its integration test runs a 'pilot session' with no task covering recruitment or acquisition of real responses. The dependent variable's real-data source is unaddressed, and plan.md's 'survey simulation' framing suggests the tasks silently accept simulated collection.

Plan Constitution Check VI and stimulus.schema.yaml require moral_intent_preservation_score ≥0.90 computed via the bert-moral-intent model, and T003 writes this field — but no task defines, builds, or validates that computation. The field will be written with no defined source, violating Single Source of Truth.

FR-006 requires effect sizes 'calculated using Type III Sums of Squares or equivalent'; T006 specifies only odds ratios and CIs with no Type III SS or stated equivalent. State the equivalent or add the computation.
SC-003 requires the family-wise error rate to be measured against nominal alpha to verify the correction; T006 only applies Bonferroni/Tukey. No task produces verification evidence for SC-003.
T006 writes data/results/results.json while data-model.md specifies data/processed/results.json. Reconcile the canonical output path (Single Source of Truth).
